Implementing the Raku® Programming Language v6.d.

methodology: Five alternating samples after one warmup per version; Red 0.2.7, SQLite in memory, no concurrent tests. School includes startup, schema and tracing. Aggregate workload times 200 fresh on-demand state reconstructions across 10 streams, excluding setup, with tracing disabled. Equivalent isolated source snapshots and warmed precompilation caches are used for both versions.
